$comment: What a person might do, played on every screen size during All the Spaces' checks. Positions are fractions of the screen (0 to 1). Then the fishing: the rod (R), a cast (F does what the left mouse button does), the cooler (I). Escape closes the first-play guide if it has come up by then; the waits are long because a device without a graphics card plays it slowly. Then the weather, for the rain's, the lightning's and the hurricane's cost: the clock's menu (T) picks it (the checks play on their own, so a pick holds); it opens on its first button and the arrows move between its buttons, round from the last to the first (0 holds the clock, 1-4 rest until dawn, noon, dusk and night, 5 is the forecast, 6-15 calm to a hurricane, a southerly gale after the gale), Space takes one, and a rest jumps the clock, so the weather is all there at once instead of coming in over minutes. A shower (rain) at noon, a thunderstorm at dusk, then a hurricane picked at dusk: through its rain at night, three hours before its eye; half a minute on (the night's clock runs four times as fast), its wall, its strongest wind and rain, half an hour or so before its eye; and the next dawn, what it has torn and its wrack up the beach. Then the forecast again, and rests to dawn until the fifth, day 6's, when the first of the forecast's westerlies sends its swell round the bay's western arm (picked weather never does), so its shore field is solved and drawn (no screenshot: the checks count what it costs all through the play, and every screenshot of their own takes a busy server many seconds). The waits between presses let a slow frame take each one. (M15) After the cooler, offshore, for what it costs out there: F8, in a driven browser alone (game/CheckSpots.js), takes the boat 20 km out and to the bank, and brings you back ((M17) in that order, so each boat's built once: the sportfisher far out, the lobster boat at the bank and home) (tools/far-sea.mjs goes to the other spots: every stop here's time on all four screens, and the checks have 25 minutes). (v2.1.5) Six screenshots, one of each thing worth seeing: the cast, the cooler, far out, the thunderstorm, the hurricane's wall and the dawn after it; the walk, the bank, the shower and the hurricane's first rain are still played but not shot, since each shot waits for a whole frame drawn on the CPU (the shower's was 28 s on one core) and v2.1.4's four screens ran past the server's 25 minutes on its second import.
